name: editor
description: Open-source 3D architectural editor with a local CLI, MCP tools, and practical workflows for humans and AI agents.
one_liner: A free, browser-based 3D tool for designing buildings and rooms, that AI agents can also drive directly to help lay things out.
buyer: An interior designer, real-estate agent, or furniture retailer who needs to show clients realistic room layouts without expensive CAD software or a hired 3D artist.
business_use_cases: A furniture retailer embeds it as a 'design your room with our products' tool on their e-commerce site to boost conversion and reduce returns.
A real-estate agent uses it to quickly mock up renovation or staging ideas for listings without hiring a 3D artist.
An interior-design freelancer uses the CLI/MCP tooling to let an AI agent draft first-pass room layouts from a client brief, then refines them.

money_ideas.idea: Build and sell an embeddable 'design your space' widget for furniture and home-decor e-commerce sites.
Offer a done-for-you rendering service: take a client's room photos/specs and deliver a finished 3D layout.

steal_this: Build a simple 'drag our furniture catalog into your room' embed for one local furniture store this weekend using the existing editor and product placement.
